definitions.explanation: An exchange of questions and answers, as in a Zen dialogue ({禅問答|ぜんもんどう}) or a question-and-answer session.
A dispute in which each side keeps answering the other. Common in {問答無用|もんどうむよう} (no arguments).

examples.japanese: {問答|もんどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧。
examples.english: To go through round after round of questions and answers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{弟子|でし}→弟子：03986_deshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{問答|もんどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{本|ほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The dialogue between the master and his disciple is recorded in the book.

examples.japanese: ⟦{禅|ぜん}→禅：03757_zen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{問答|もんどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{過程|かてい}→過程：02621_katei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧。
examples.english: Zen dialogues value the process of thinking more than the answer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問答無用|もんどうむよう}→問答無用：17316_mondoumuyou⟧だ。
⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入口|いりぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{問答|もんどう}になった。
examples.english: The clerk and the customer got into an argument at the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{問答|もんどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}し→繰り返し：10320_kurikaeshi⟧で、⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}まない→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: However often I explain, it's the same back-and-forth, and we get nowhere.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{問答無用|もんどうむよう}→問答無用：17316_mondoumuyou⟧: no arguments; without discussion
- {禅問答|ぜんもんどう}: a Zen dialogue; figuratively, an exchange that makes no sense
- {押|お}し{問答|もんどう}: a heated back-and-forth (at a door, a counter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{質疑応答|しつぎおうとう}→質疑応答：16289_shitsugioutou⟧: Q&A after a talk or in a meeting — the usual formal term today
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧: discussion, debate — reasoned argument rather than back-and-forth
